entries.name: London Centre for the Study of Contemporary Antisemitism (LCSCA)
entries.description: Interdisciplinary scholarship on contemporary antisemitism, including its intellectual and institutional contexts. The website provides research publications, reports, seminars and conference information.

entries.name: Institute for the Study of Global Antisemitism and Policy (ISGAP)
entries.description: An interdisciplinary institute studying global antisemitism and its implications for public policy. Resources include research papers, lectures and educational programmes.

entries.name: Institute for the Study of Contemporary Antisemitism (ISCA)
entries.description: Research on the intellectual, ideological, social and cultural sources of contemporary antisemitism. The institute offers courses, scholarly lectures and conferences.

entries.name: Vidal Sassoon International Center for the Study of Antisemitism (SICSA)
entries.description: Interdisciplinary research on historical and contemporary antisemitism, including comparative perspectives on discrimination. Its resources include publications, bibliographic material and academic events.

entries.name: Elizabeth and Tony Comper Center for the Study of Antisemitism
entries.description: An interdisciplinary university centre for the study of antisemitism. Its website introduces research projects, publications, academic programmes and public events.

entries.name: Center for Research on Antisemitism (ZfA)
entries.description: Research and teaching on antisemitism, exclusion, hostility and violence in historical and contemporary contexts, alongside related forms of racism. Resources include projects, publications and teaching programmes.

entries.name: Birkbeck Institute for the Study of Antisemitism (BISA)
entries.description: Research and teaching on antisemitism, racialisation and religious intolerance. The institute brings together scholarship, seminars and resources for wider public discussion.

entries.name: Decoding Antisemitism
entries.description: Research on explicit and implicit antisemitism in online discourse. Its reports and publications combine detailed qualitative analysis with computational approaches to identifying antisemitic content.

entries.name: Center for the Study of Contemporary European Jewry
entries.description: Research on contemporary Jewish life, identity, culture and relations between Jews and non-Jews. The centre also publishes reports on contemporary antisemitism.

entries.name: Institute for Jewish Policy Research (JPR)
entries.description: Social research on Jewish communities, including demography, identity, antisemitism and community life. Its survey reports and research archive are useful starting points for studying contemporary Jewish populations.

entries.name: Moses Mendelssohn Center for European-Jewish Studies (MMZ)
entries.description: Research on European-Jewish history, culture and society, with work on antisemitism and right-wing extremism. The centre also develops public-history and digital-humanities projects.

entries.name: German Centre for Integration and Migration Research (DeZIM)
entries.description: Research on migration, integration, discrimination and racism, as well as social participation and conflict. Its reports and research infrastructure provide wider context for work on minority experiences and belonging.

entries.name: Psychology of Intergroup Conflict and Reconciliation Lab (PICR)
entries.description: Social-psychological research on intergroup conflict and reconciliation, including group-based emotions and interventions intended to improve relations between groups. The lab website presents projects and publications.

entries.name: aChord Center
entries.institution: Affiliated with the Hebrew University of Jerusalem
entries.description: Applied social psychology aimed at improving relations between social groups. Its work connects research on prejudice and intergroup relations with practice in education, employment and higher education.

entries.name: ReHOPE Research Hub
entries.institution: Based at the PICR Lab, Hebrew University of Jerusalem
entries.description: Research on hope and its role in social and political life. The hub presents studies and publications on how people understand desired futures and respond to conflict.

entries.name: Culture + Intergroup Relations Lab (Kimel Lab)
entries.description: Research on how culture and identity shape relations between groups, including responses to exclusion and intergroup conflict. The website provides an introduction to the lab and its publications.

entries.name: Social Identity and Groups Network (SIGN)
entries.description: Research on social identity and group processes, including how social connections affect health and wellbeing. The network also studies leadership, social change and relations between groups.

entries.name: Social Identity & Health Lab
entries.description: Research on social identity, discrimination, stress and health. Its work examines how identity and social experiences relate to coping with challenges such as illness and trauma.
